task_goal: Land the rocket at coordinates (0,0) safely with minimal time and fuel consumption.

action_space.note: Continuous mode supported but discrete is primary for bang-bang control.

termination_modes: Crash detected (game_over flag triggered by body contact)
success_like_ending: Position within pad bounds (abs(state[0]) < threshold, state[1] approx 0)
Low vertical velocity magnitude at contact
failure_like_endings: Crash detected (game_over flag triggered by body contact)
behavior_trajectory_prior: Descent initiation: Orient lander towards pad and reduce altitude.
Alignment: Use side engines to correct angle to near zero.
Velocity damping: Reduce vertical velocity using main engine before touchdown.
Final touchdown: Ensure both legs contact ground simultaneously with low impact.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing
Oscillating near pad without committing to final descent
Intentional crashing for quick episode reset if negative reward is insufficient
